intended_object: A ZMod p coefficient used inside the library's chain-level boundary computation for one particular middle-prism collar in a Fox–Neuwirth order-complex construction (for the Nandakumar–Ramana Rao proof). It is the upper-endpoint pairing evaluated on the indicator of a facet orbit. This is inferred from the docstring and from how the definition is used.
explanation: The definition just pairs a library-specific facet-orbit indicator with a library-specific upper-endpoint pairing. Several files in the development define coefficients with the same name in the same pattern. Their only role is to state and prove boundary/Stokes-type identities (upper coefficient minus lower coefficient, weighted sums) inside a larger proof. They are bookkeeping for a particular cellular chain computation. The literature has no standalone notion like this, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
